no_frequency_model: No edit probabilities, no weighted workload score, no average real-world speedup (CORRECTIVE-B §41).
population_statement: The frozen sampling frame is a curated population of retrievable open-source technical Markdown/documentation from the 20 pinned sources in PR #34. It is not a random sample of all Markdown usage.
target_population_note: REPRESENTATIVE_SET is coverage-oriented: it covers major observed real-document regimes in the frozen candidate population, not a frequency-weighted sample of all Markdown users.
